newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stockholm Energi, IVO to form electricity company.
newsitem.headline: Stockholm Energi, IVO to form electricity company.

text.p: Sweden's Stockholm Energi and Finland's Imatran Voima OY (IVO) said on Monday they had agreed to form a joint company, Birka Kraft AB, to produce and distribute electricty in Sweden.

Birka Kraft AB will be jointly owned by the two companies and its headquarters will be in Stockholm, the owners said in a joint statement. The agreement was subject to approval by Swedish authorities, they added.
"The new company will offer operating and maintenance services for power generation," it said.
